title: Barack Obama just delivered one stunning reality check that left Democrats shell-shocked
text:
Democrats are spiraling into complete chaos after Donald Trump’s landslide victory.
The party can’t figure out how to respond to Trump’s unstoppable momentum.
And Barack Obama just delivered one stunning reality check that left Democrats shell-shocked.
Obama tells Democrats to stop acting like babies The Democrat Party is in total disarray after President Trump roared back into the White House with a clear mandate from the American people.
Democrats have been wandering around Washington, D.C. like lost sheep ever since Trump demolished Kamala Harris in November.
Now Barack Obama is desperately trying to get his fellow Democrats to snap out of their funk and start fighting back against the America First agenda.
During a private fundraiser at New Jersey Governor Phil Murphy’s home, Obama delivered some brutal home truths to party bigwigs who’ve been moping around since Election Day.
"I think it’s going to require a little bit less navel-gazing and a little less whining and being in fetal positions. And it’s going to require Democrats to just toughen up," Obama said according to excerpts obtained by CNN.¹
The former President basically told his party to quit acting like crybabies and start doing something productive for once.
Obama’s frustration with his own party was obvious as he watched Democrats completely fall apart after Trump’s historic comeback.
President Trump has been openly mocking Democrats for being "in total disarray" and not having any clear leadership.
And he’s absolutely right.
Democrats can’t find their footing against Trump’s dominance While Republicans have been united behind Trump since 2016, Democrats are still searching for someone who can even remotely challenge his political dominance.
Obama tried to downplay the leadership crisis but his comments revealed just how desperate the situation has become.
"Stop looking for the quick fix. Stop looking for the messiah. You have great candidates running races right now. Support those candidates," Obama urged the crowd of wealthy donors.²
The 44th President admitted that Democrats need to focus on upcoming off-year elections in New Jersey and Virginia as "a big jumpstart for where we need to go."
But that’s a pretty low bar when you’re talking about trying to stop the Trump juggernaut.
Obama also revealed that the Democrat Party is so broke they’ve had to take out a line of credit just to keep the lights on.
"We’ve got to start building up our coffers," Obama stressed, highlighting how the party apparatus has been forced into financial desperation.³
The fundraiser managed to rake in about $2.5 million, but that’s pocket change compared to what Republicans are bringing in with Trump leading the charge.
Obama admits Trump has no guardrails to stop him Perhaps the most telling part of Obama’s speech was when he basically admitted that Trump is unstoppable.
"I don’t want to know your ideology, because you can’t build anything. It does not matter," Obama said, taking a shot at the far-left wing of his own party that’s been fighting with moderates.⁴
Obama also confessed that he hasn’t been "surprised by what Trump’s done" or that "there are no more guardrails within the Republican Party."⁵
So Obama’s basically admitting Trump owns the Republican Party now and he’s got them running like clockwork.
Meanwhile, Democrats can’t stop bickering with each other while Trump just keeps winning.
Obama tried to get his people fired up by telling them to show some "courage" and quit moping around.
"Don’t tell me you’re a Democrat, but you’re kind of disappointed right now so you’re not doing anything. No, now is exactly the time that you get in there and do something," Obama said.⁶
But here’s the thing – what can they actually do when Trump’s getting stuff done and they can’t even figure out what they stand for?
The Democrat civil war just got uglier Obama’s little pep talk exposed just how badly the Democrat Party is falling apart behind the scenes.
He even brought up the nasty "argument between the left of the party and people who are promoting the quote-unquote abundance agenda."⁷
You’ve got the crazy progressives who hate America fighting with the so-called moderates who pretend they care about regular folks.
Obama’s trying to smooth things over, but let’s be honest – Democrats don’t have a clue what working families actually want.
Trump figured out how to put America First and that’s why he keeps crushing it.
These Democrats? They’re still fighting the same old fights from 2016 while Trump’s already moved on to making America great again.
The Democrat National Committee has been a complete mess with all kinds of internal drama and backstabbing.
And get this – Obama’s big fundraiser was just a bunch of rich elites hanging out at some governor’s mansion trying to figure out how to fool regular Americans.
That’s pretty rich coming from people who wouldn’t know a working-class voter if they tripped over one.
Obama can talk tough all he wants, but Democrats are getting steamrolled by a President who actually does what he says he’ll do.
Here’s what really gets them – they’ve got nothing to fight back with because Trump’s America First agenda actually works.
All the money and fancy speeches in the world won’t fix that problem.
